text: I find myself intrigued and curious—first, I see a group of people gathered in discussion behind glass, perhaps a meeting or workshop. There is a sense of anticipation, of ideas about to be exchanged. Moving on, I encounter the vibrant R+D wall—bold colors and text about research and development. Here, energy and innovation seem tangible, inviting contemplation about the role of knowledge, progress, and collaboration. I feel on the edge of discovery, sensing possibilities in these ordinary, yet purposeful, modern spaces.
